# cms commands

Every `cms` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `cms:map:build`

Project each site's map of places into the graph.

```bash
bin/semitexa cms:map:build
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | no |

## `cms:translate:drain`

Translate content whose debounce window has closed.

```bash
bin/semitexa cms:translate:drain
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--batch` | yes |
